scope: (1) every evidence row of the 22 sampled records for name, address, parent_company, products, prospect_test, exclusion_reason, welder_postings, headcount and status (membership); 12 city rows were also read (all confirmed) but are left out of the rate. decision_rule: Corrected = the value adds a fact the cited page does not show, tags a judgement as stated, places a company-level fact at the plant, or the quote is not on the page (raw source and browser re-fetch checked first). Confirmed otherwise. Unreachable = could not be read (not confirmed, not in the rate). Membership disagreements go to membership_disputes, not the rate. 'posted' vs 'listed' wording is noted, not counted.
repeated_kinds: other = judgement tagged stated (9 of 12 corrections): 6 exclusion_reason rows carrying a rule-5/R2/out-of-definition ruling tagged stated (Interstates Topeka, MMR Lafayette, Eaton Smyrna, Electroswitch, KEB, Schneider Cedar Rapids), 2 board-absence ('none found' / 'none with a welder title') readings tagged stated (IE South Point, Eaton Fayetteville), 1 campus judgement in a stated address row (SPS). membership_disputes.dispute: The only site evidence is the word 'assembly facility' in an announcement (2025-10-06; existing building to be renovated) of 'modular electrical systems' for data centers. R2 needs site evidence of only electrical/mechanical assembly (bench wiring, fit-out of bought-in enclosures), which this does not show; the other MMR OSHA records are other sites. Read as pre-production with a possible rule-1 product (modular electrical/power-distribution systems), R4 would keep it base, as FTI Monroe was kept on its announced Excellerate product. Either settle 'modular electrical systems' as not rule-1 in writing or move to base, prospect unknown.

Williamstown's own announced product is only 'critical electrical infrastructure that supports data centers' (governor release 2026-07-08); the welded steel skids are the Reno OH plant's work. Rule 2 says a company-level line decides relationship, not membership, so R4's 'rule-1 product' test is met only by importing the sister plant's work. Kept base by explicit coordinator ruling (R4 names it); flagged as inconsistent with rule 2, not counted.
